messages:
mike_release: Heads up — I ran a quick canary prep and noticed summarize-v3 (quant-v4b) shows quality regression when routed to runtime-2.14. Proposing temporary soft-pin of runtime=2.13 for model_group=summarize-v3 while we push a routing/fallback patch. Suggest 6h window and a staged canary (1% -> 25%). @sophie_ml @anna_dev @ops_oncall :wave:

sophie_ml: repro'd loss on long-seq eval. rouge_l drops ~1.8 on our internal evalset for sequences >2k when using 2.14. Looks like KV-cache handling changed in the new runtime for quantized kernels. +1 for pin until we patch. :thinking_face:

anna_dev: routing patch would be cleaner (route quant-v4b to pool with runtime-2.12/2.13) but needs a deploybot rollout. If we pin at infra level it'll stop new nodes from picking up 2.14 which is safer short-term. Recommend pin + routing override as a belt+braces approach.

deploy-bot: schedule acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy pin --runtime 2.13 --group summarize-v3 --duration 6h --by mike_release
```
Will attempt canary routing after pining.

ops_oncall: Quick checklist — do we have rollback steps if routing/pin causes other regressions? Recommend a 10-min 1% canary, alert if latency p50 increases >10ms or rouge_l drops >1.5. Also add a short-circuit to fully unpin if monitor fires.

mike_release: Agreed. Plan: 1% for 10m, if stable ramp to 25% for 30m, then auto-evaluate. Alerts: latency_p50, latency_p95, rouge_l_drop, error_rate. I will add a temporary monitor dashboard and the alert thresholds. Tagging @sophie_ml to push eval run now. :white_check_mark:

sophie_ml: Kicked off eval: `scripts/eval_longseq.sh summarize-v3 quant-v4b` — will post results in ~30m. Also added an automated regression check to the canary job.

deploy-bot: Pinning complete: runtime=2.13 applied to group=summarize-v3. Canary routing set: 1% -> 25% per plan. Monitors attached: latency_p50, latency_p95, rouge_l, error_rate. Notifying @mike_release for signoff.

anna_dev: Canary metrics coming in: p50 +2ms, p95 +8ms, rouge_l -0.8. Within thresholds. Keeping at 25% for 30m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
